title: LXC 111: implement the Palworld settings capability (read/write the server's own settings file)
description:
On LXC 111, add a backend route that reads and writes the Palworld server's settings (switches etc.) by editing the Palworld config file at PALWORLD_IP 192.168.1.106 over SSH as PALWORLD_USER aedefruscio, exposing GET/PUT of the settings keys. No UI yet. On container 111. Done when `pct exec 111 -- grep -n 'palworld' /opt/control-panel-backend/server.js` shows it.
